info.name: SupportDesk Pro Backend API
info.description:
Postman collection for the SupportDesk Pro backend REST API.

Setup:
1. Start the backend at `http://localhost:4000`.
2. Import this collection into Postman.
3. Run `Auth / Register` or `Auth / Login`. The test script stores `accessToken`, `userId`, `orgId`, and `userRole` from the JWT.
4. Create resources in normal order: team/SLA policy -> ticket -> comments/attachments/CSAT/webhooks/etc.

Collection variables are used for reusable IDs. Create requests include small test scripts that save returned IDs when the response contains `data.id`.
